Questions

Before you arrive

Do I need experience with sound healing or journaling?

No. The evening is guided and beginner-friendly. You can participate at your own comfort level.

What should I bring?

Bring a yoga mat and water bottle, and wear comfortable clothing. You may also bring a light blanket or small pillow for added comfort.

Will I have to share in the community circle?

No. The circle is intended to feel safe and welcoming. Listening quietly is also a valid way to participate.

Is the event suitable if I feel stressed or overwhelmed?

The experience is designed to support rest, reflection, and a calmer setting. It is complementary wellness support, not medical or mental-health treatment.
